newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-May copper imports up 11.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-May copper imports up 11.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's imports of copper reached 536,383 tonnes in the first five months, up 11.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, the China Securities said on Friday, quoting customs figures.
Imports in May alone were 138,504 tonnes, it said.
Imports of unwrought copper and copper materials reached 259,694 tonnes in January-May, up 7.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Imports of unwrought copper and copper materials in May alone were 63,716 tonnes, up 4.06 percent, it said.
Imports of unwrought copper including alloys were 73,818 tonnes in the first five months, a drop of 21.4 percent compared with the same period in 1996, it said.
Imports for May alone were 19,670 tonnes, up by 5.47 percent, it said.
